description.value: The Dayton Audio Epique E150MR-8 is a wide-band midrange driver designed to deliver clear, fast, and controlled sound across nearly 7 octaves. Focused on low distortion and high efficiency, it uses an advanced motor design and carefully selected materials to produce clean, accurate output from 70 to 7,000 Hz. A rigid cast frame, carbon fiber cone, and effective cooling ensure stable, dependable performance, while the matching carbon fiber cone weave maintains a consistent look with other Epique drivers-making the E150MR-8 a strong choice for premium home audio systems, studio monitors, and custom loudspeaker designs. Product Highlights High-performance wide-band midrange driver covering a wide, usable frequency range from 70 to 7,000 Hz 8-ohm configuration designed for high efficiency and powerful, dynamic output Lightweight yet rigid carbon fiber cone with indexed cone and surround for a smooth transition minimizing diffraction Advanced motor design featuring a copper cap and aluminum shorting sleeve to significantly reduce distortionTitanium former paired with a solid aluminum phase plug for enhanced thermal stability and improved detail Titanium former paired with a solid aluminum phase plug for enhanced thermal stability and improved detail Rigid cast frame that minimizes vibration and ensures stable, precise operation Matching carbon fiber cone weave aligns with existing Epique drivers for seamless aesthetic continuity across multi-driver systems

model.value: E150MR-8 5-1/2" Wide-Band Carbon Fiber Midrange Driver 8 Ohm
